statement: A private company allots new shares (other than a deemed allotment to subscribers on formation) by lodging with the Registrar a return of the allotment stating the number of shares, the amounts paid and unpaid, the class, and each member's particulars and holdings; an allotment made on or after 3 January 2016 does not take effect until the Registrar updates the company's electronic register of members.
caveat: The filing is constitutive, not declaratory: ACRA's electronic register of members is the legal record for private companies, so a round has not closed until the register updates. Public companies file under section 63A and keep their own register instead.
reviewer: Starter editorial review; independent domain expert review pending
